description: This file implements an HTTP handler for the OpenResponses API endpoint '/v1/responses' in the OpenClaw Gateway. It manages request parsing, input extraction, session management, synchronous and streaming responses, and integrates with agent commands and event handling.

methods.name: wrapUntrustedFileContent
methods.description: Wraps file content with external content warning or formatting.

methods.name: normalizeResponseSessionScope
methods.description: Normalizes the response session scope by trimming relevant fields.

methods.name: resolveResponseSessionAuthSubject
methods.description: Determines the auth subject string based on request headers and auth mode.

methods.name: createResponseSessionScope
methods.description: Creates a response session scope object from request and auth info.

methods.name: matchesResponseSessionScope
methods.description: Checks if a session entry matches a given scope.

methods.name: pruneExpiredResponseSessions
methods.description: Removes expired session entries from the session map.

methods.name: evictOverflowResponseSessions
methods.description: Evicts oldest session entries to maintain max size.

methods.name: storeResponseSession
methods.description: Stores or updates a response session entry.

methods.name: lookupResponseSession
methods.description: Retrieves a session key for a response ID if it matches scope and TTL.

methods.name: writeSseEvent
methods.description: Writes a Server-Sent Events message to the response.

methods.name: resolveResponsesLimits
methods.description: Resolves configuration limits for responses, files, and images.

methods.name: extractClientTools
methods.description: Converts response body tools into internal client tool definitions.

methods.name: applyToolChoice
methods.description: Applies tool choice logic to filter and prompt for tools.

methods.name: createEmptyUsage
methods.description: Creates an empty usage object.

methods.name: toUsage
methods.description: Converts a usage-like object into a standardized Usage object.

methods.name: extractUsageFromResult
methods.description: Extracts usage information from agent command result.

methods.name: resolveStopReasonAndPendingToolCalls
methods.description: Extracts stop reason and pending tool calls from metadata.

methods.name: createResponseResource
methods.description: Constructs a response resource object with given parameters.

methods.name: createAssistantOutputItem
methods.description: Creates an output item for assistant message.

methods.name: createFunctionCallOutputItem
methods.description: Creates an output item for a function call.

methods.name: runResponsesAgentCommand
methods.description: Executes the agent command for responses, handling message, images, tools, and prompts.

methods.name: handleOpenResponsesHttpRequest
methods.description: Main handler for the '/v1/responses' endpoint, managing request parsing, input extraction, session management, and response delivery (including streaming).
